retrieve_coeffs: retrieve polynomial fit coefficients for a specific impurity element from COEFFS
lookup_temperature_intervals: lookup temperature intervals in eV for a given impurity element from TEMPERATURE_INTERVALS
get_min_temperature: get the minimum valid temperature in eV for an impurity from MIN_TEMPERATURES
get_max_temperature: get the maximum valid temperature in eV for an impurity from MAX_TEMPERATURES
summarize_impurity_data: summarize the available impurity elements and their charge state polynomial data
